messages:
Ava: ok new low for home office theft: Finnegan (ragdoll) has been stealthily liberating my pens and leaving them in a semicircle around my laptop. photo: https://cdn.redwood.app/finnegan/3344556677_pen_semicircle.jpg
Riley: omg that's a curated exhibit. curator Finnegan.
Diego: is that a blue gel pen, two highlighters, and a Post-it flag cascade? spectacular.
Ava: yes and he put the click-tops facing outward like hes mocking my inability to close tabs.
Jae: teach him Git and were hiring. :joy:
Riley: also low-key impressed he didnt chew them. discipline.
Ava: uploaded a short clip of the heist in action 1 see the paw grab at 0:04.
uploader-bot: Uploaded file "finnegan_pen_heist.mov" 1 https://cdn.redwood.app/finnegan/3344556677_heist.mov
Diego: watched it  impeccable timing. worthy of a silent film soundtrack.
Riley: poll: official job title for Finnegan? options: "Chief Pen Officer", "Head of Stationery Logistics", "Petty Thief"
Ava: :thumbsup: Chief Pen Officer
Diego: :thumbsup: Head of Stationery Logistics
Jae: :thumbsup: Petty Thief
Riley: also awarding extra kudos if anyone else has a pet with a weird collection habit.
Ava: saving this thread for my future self so i can show the team evidence when he denies everything. :smile:
